subject: Quick coffee chat — Staff Product Engineer (Montevideo) at LawnStarter
body:
Hi Alex Recruiter,

I recently applied / am preparing an application for Staff Product Engineer (Montevideo) at LawnStarter. I would value a short 15-minute coffee chat to learn how your team approaches the work (my background includes data analysis, SQL, Python, and stakeholder reporting).

Happy to work around your calendar — even a brief LinkedIn reply helps.

Best,
